newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi airline carries 135,474 outbound pilgrims.
newsitem.headline: Saudi airline carries 135,474 outbound pilgrims.

text.p: Saudi Arabian Airlines carried 135,474 haj pilgrims on 461 flights out of the kingdom in the two weeks ending on May 4, an airline official said.

"Saudia had transported to the kingdom 312,300 pilgrims for this year's haj season from different parts of the world," the English-language daily Arab News quoted Abdul Rahman al-Mahboub, the Jeddah services general manager, as saying.
The airline had leased nine Boeing 747 aircraft during the haj when two million Moslems -- half of them from abroad -- travelled to holy sites near Mecca during April.
